translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus a Faingiir Rhooawe Mesaemmwaen Rhooan Kkayeo
Eraaen nge Jesus e iu reen meoneoiniun we Gennesaret nipwaen aar aeremas aekkaetemaegin to pwe repwe itto rongorong miniwe kkepesaen Deus.
A weri riiufoarh pwoot pwe ra iuriiur tae weni ppiy: nge rhooan fita kkewe ra nigiti pwe ra noa wupwuuw noa wuug kkewe naiiur.

Jesus a toonong noan efoarh pwoot kkewe — pwoot we waen Simon — nge a tingoareei ngaere epwe mmwenen amman saengi egius mwoarhoisaet. Jesus a mooat noan pwoot we nge a fenai ngaeniir rhooa towunap we.
Enoa moann aan mwaenieniy, nge a aengaeni Simon pwe, “Ammaan ffoarh wow igina e nennoan ee, nge een me rhooa kkomwu rhinoamw oawwa aerheei tiw wuug mwu naimi pwe oawpwe fita.”
Simon a paniuwaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, efoarh ngaeni nee pwoong we aemaem fita nge esooar iig e aei nipaeni. Iwe ngaere ina minimwu wo iura, ina nge iya iseni tiw wuug kka naimaem.”
Ra iseni tiw wuug kkewe nge ra igin niyap iig nge aetae epwene ffeir wuug kkewe.

Iwe nge ra taenepom ngaeniir rhooa kkewe rhoaniuwaar wooan pwoot we efoarh pwe repwe itto tipaengiir. Re itto iwe ra itto oawuta pwoot kkewe waar e sseogtae reen iig aetae pwoot kkewe repwene mweoius.
Oatowe Simon Peter a weri miniwe a wen, a foatotiw weni mmwaen Jesus nge a iura pwe, “Siu saengiaei Soamwoon! Ngaang erhai mwaaen monofit!”
Iiy me rhooa kkewe ra riutae reen towunepaen iig kkewe ra nipaeni.
Pwan ina rhag miniwe ewen ngaeniir James me John, mwaaen kkewe naiun Zebedee. Jesus a aengaeni Simon pwe, “Wosoapw mesag: saengi igina a noa een wopwene niyap aeremas.”
Ra iuriutae pwoot kkewe waar weni ppiy, nigititiw oanongaen aegiaeg, nge ra tapweei noa Jesus.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen

Eew oat nge Jesus eno noan eew aepinoamw igiwe erhai mwaaen eweri eew kaenepaai eno ee. Igiwe eweri Jesus, a foatotiw wooan ppweon nge a aeffaenipirhe ngaeni pwe, “Menap, aere wo mwerhaen, wa aecchipwanoa aaei semwaai!”
Jesus e angenoa nge a geotteopa mwaaen we, nge a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ngaang i mwerhaen, wone cchipw noa!” Reen rhag oatowe nge kaenepaai we a rhiuw saengi mwaaen we.

Jesus a ammwir ngaeni pwe, “Esooar ne wopwe aengaeni minneei, nge faaeraeg uwen noa reen patere pwe epwe weriug. Iwe nge a feeori oasoar we Moses e akkiuneo, pwe epwe pwaeri ngaeniir aeremas pwe wa nimegacch noa.”
Miniwe kkepesaen Jesus a rheeoi fetaen, iwe pwuwaen aeremas ra maegeto repwe itto aiussaening ngaeni nge e aecchipwa aar semwaai.
Iwe nge egaen noa pwiuneoi e esooar aeremas ee, nge a noa maeipin ee.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen Maemerhoar

Eraaen nge Jesus e fenai, nge aaemweoi Pharisees me sinsein anniug remooat igiwe, nge re itto me wooan aepinoamwon Galilee me Judea me Jerusalem. Kkeman we aaen Soamwoon eno wooan Jesus pwe epwe mmwenen aecchipwaar rhooa semwaai.
Aaemweoi mwaaen re pwigito erhai mwaaen e maemerhoar wooan eew giegiy, re aegina pwe repwe pwigi nong noan iimw we nge ra oawnatiw weni mmwaen Jesus.

Pwonno reen pwuwaen aeremas we, iwe rese mmwenen repwe toori Jesus. Iwe ra teeotae wooan iimw we, ra feingi noa aekkaew oason iimw we, nge re atairaetiw mwaaen we noan giegiy we nugunupaen pwuwa we me weni mmwaen Jesus.
Igiwe Jesus a weri nepaen aar niugiuniug rhooawe, a aengaeni mwaaen we pwe, “Naeyi, monofitimw a mwusunoa.”
Sinsein anniug kkewe me Pharisees kkewe a rhaepetae aar niuwaennei fengaen wooar pwe, “Iyo mwaaen e aepesa aenneewa Deus! Deus rhag minne emmwen epwe oamwusa noa monofit!”
Jesus e giuneei niunniuwaen kkewe aar nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta oaw niuwaennei minikkena e aenneew reen?
E mererhaeg pwe sipwe aepesa pwe, ‘Monofitimw a mwusunoa,’ aere sipwe aepesa pwe, ‘Iutae wa faaeraeg noa’?

Ipwe pwaeri ngaenigaemi pwe mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas eyor maemaewan wooan soanop pwe epwe oamwusa noa monofit.” Iwe a aengaeni mwaaen maemerhoar we pwe, “Ipwe aengaeniug, iutae, pwigi giemw wa noa noan imwoamw!”
Iwe rhag mwaaen we a iutae me weni mmweer rhooawe, a pwigi miniwe gien iwe ewon wooan, a noa nee pwugusan, a noa aepingepinga Deus.
Oanongeer rhooawe ra gin riutae reen aar mesag, nge ra aepingepinga Deus nge ra iura pwe, “A inamwo aemwaeraeran minikka sa weri noan raaeneei!”
Jesus a Faingi Levi
Mwirin minneei, Jesus a noa weri erhai rhooan iyoiyon tax itan Levi, emooat noan aan office. Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Itto tapweaei.”
Iwe Levi a iutae nigiti oanongaen aegiaeg nge a tapweei noa mwirin.
Oatona nge Levi a feeori eew gupwun gin temoag me reen iimw na imwan pwe aaen Jesus, iwe nge neeiir rhooan itto tapweei gupwun we nge regin ssow rhooan iyoiyon tax me pwan aaemweoi aeremas.

Aaemweoi Pharisees me sinsein anniug re appaniuwaen ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun Jesus re iura pwe, “Meeta oaw iun nge oaw mwongo ngaeniir rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooa aenneew wegitaegiir kkomwun reen?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir a iura pwe, “Rhooakka rese semwaai rese noa reer toagota, pwe rhooakka refaer semwaai.
Ngaang ise itto pwe ipwe faingiir rhooa mwamwaai, pwe faer rhooa monofit pwe repwe toagun saengi monofitiir.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Aecchigipin

Aekkaaemweoi aeremas re aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun John regaen aecchigipin ffoarh noa rhag nge re maeipin ffoarh, pwan ina rhag rhooan akkiuneo kka naiiur Pharisees; nge rhooan kkayeo kkomwu noawumw re mwongo noa rhag me re iun noa rhag.”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Oaw niuwaennei pwe epwe mmwen oawsoapw oamwongoor aeremas kkewe re itto reen gupwunon appwiuniupai igiwe bridegroom we e rhiuwen no reer? Aapw!
Nge epwe itto raaenin na repwe pwigi saengiir bridegroom we, nge ina oatona repwene aecchigipin noa.”

Jesus a pwan aengaeniir fioangon awewe een: “Oawsoapw taeringa eew mengaag ffeo pwe oawpwe pinisa ngaeni eew mengaag maerhiy. Esooar ipitan oawpwe feeori. Iwe ngaere epwe ina, oawwa taeringa mwaenenei noa mengaag ffeo we pwe ikka mengaag ffeo we ese aeffitaeg ngaeni mengaag maerhiy we.
Oawsoapw pwan aenianong wine ffeo noan nenien wine maerhiy, pwonno wine ffeo we epwe taeringatiw nenien wine maerhiy we, iwe a nipi noa wine we nge nenien wine we a ffeir noa.
Wine ffeo ina oawpwan ngoannong rhag noan nenien wine ffeo!
Nge esooar erhai ne epwe iun wine maerhiy nge epwe pwan rhiuwen iun wine ffeo. Pwe e iura pwe, ‘Wine kka e ssiunaei minne enneo.’ ”
